question: Does geometry of early continuation activations improve out-of-family prediction of official robustness labels beyond structure, confidence, prose sensitivity and temporal uncertainty?
layer_rule: Decoder block output at zero-based index ceil(0.75 * number_of_decoder_blocks) - 1, before final normalization. One layer only; no layer search.

hidden_geometry.normalization: Convert continuation-token block outputs to CPU float64, L2-normalize each token row, then center rows by their token-wise mean. Form the token Gram matrix and divide by its trace.
hidden_geometry.degenerate_policy: Fail the measurement explicitly for zero token norms or zero centered variation; no fabricated geometry or silent case exclusion.
hidden_geometry.scope: LLM-Check-inspired normalized, single-layer, fixed-prefix adaptation; not literal replication and not a mechanistic faithfulness test.

readout.standardization: Unweighted training-fold-only mean and centered second moment; scale below 1e-12 becomes one

secondary: combined is descriptive only; it cannot substitute for a failed primary candidate
bootstrap_scope: Whole-family resampling of fixed OOF predictions, conditional on fitted predictions. Intervals do not cover retraining, prior hypothesis selection or simultaneous testing uncertainty.
interpretation: Previously inspected public development data: any positive result earns external validation on genuinely new families, not a claim of winning or independent confirmation. A negative primary result closes this geometry branch; do not select a layer, threshold or alternative arm using these same held-out results.
